SELECT leaderboard.id, leaderboard.position, leaderboard.username, leaderboard.email, leaderboard.full_name,
leaderboard.object_key,
leaderboard.total_point, oap.avatar_url FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ulp.total_point DESC, ulp.modified_time IS NULL, ulp.modified_time DESC, ulp.created_time DESC ) AS position, u.id, u.username, u.email, u.full_name,
f.object_key,
ulp.total_point FROM users u JOIN user_learning_progresses ulp ON u.user_learning_progress_id = ulp.id LEFT JOIN files f ON u.avatar_file_id = f.id JOIN leagues l ON l.id = #{leagueId}
WHERE u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ulp.total_point >= l.min_point AND ( l.max_point IS NULL OR ulp.total_point <= l.max_point )) leaderboard LEFT JOIN o_auth_providers oap ON leaderboard.id = oap.user_id where leaderboard.position <= 10 ORDER BY leaderboard.position
